notes.https://github.com/meshery/meshery/pull/: Run load tests against every configured endpoint URL, not just the first one.
Propagate database and marshal errors from `GetMesheryK8sContexts` instead of silently dropping them.
Remove the unused `SetOverrideValues` from the GraphQL model.
notes.https://github.com/meshery-extensions/me: Require HTTPS for non-loopback endpoints before sending auth cookies.
Add a `design import` command for design files.
notes.https://github.com/meshery-extensions/sh: Disable Gatsby's built-in ESLint plugin so `gatsby develop` works with ESLint 10.
Fix the `svg.draw.js` import warning and migrate ESLint to flat config.
notes.https://github.com/layer5io/layer5/pull/: Preserve logo colors and keep them visible in dark mode.
notes.https://github.com/meshery/meshery.io/pu: Fix the homepage CTA alignment, hero title size and mobile text alignment.
notes.https://github.com/meshery/meshsync/pull: Add a `Discoverer` interface, with Kubernetes as the first adapter.
notes.https://github.com/meshery/schemas/pull/: Migrate model/component nested refs to camelCase wire format (v1beta2/v1beta3).
